payload.title: Tue 11/10: Referring providers: weight loss medications and the behavioral half
payload.purpose: Patients on weight loss medications (never the drug class abbreviation): the habits that keep the result. Document post.

captions.LI:
Patients on weight loss medications: the behavioral half of lasting results.

Weight loss medications can be highly effective, but the outcomes patients sustain long-term depend on the behavioral changes they build during treatment.

At the Bariatric Counseling Center, we provide the structured behavioral support that helps patients establish sustainable habits around food, movement, and emotional regulation.

Our Intensive Outpatient Program serves patients on weight loss medications through group and individual therapy, dietary guidance, cooking classes, and movement education in one coordinated format.

The staff is comprised of a clinical psychologist, licensed professional counselors, registered dietitians, movement therapists, and a registered nurse, as well as a professional chef.

We coordinate care with referring medical providers and, at patient discharge, we give referring providers a detailed summary of the patient's behavioral progress during the time in our intensive outpatient program.

We accept most health insurances. Our claims are processed under patients' mental health benefits, and patients typically attend for little to no cost.

Serving San Antonio and virtual across Texas.

Refer a patient: bariatriccounselingcenter.com/refer-a-patient/

#BehavioralHealth

payload.title: Mon 11/16: Eating at one table again
payload.purpose: Family Engagement: how the program brings the people around a client into the work, gently.

captions.FB:
Family engagement in behavioral healthcare for obesity

At the Bariatric Counseling Center, family engagement is part of the work. Not every session, not mandatory, but available when it helps.

A spouse learning how to support without monitoring. A parent understanding the difference between care and control. Adult children finding new ways to talk about food at gatherings.

Family sessions happen when a client asks, or when a counselor suggests it might help move something forward. The people around you don't need to be experts. They just need to understand what you're working on.

We provide group and individual therapy, dietary guidance, cooking classes and movement education in a unique, all-inclusive format. One program, not four. Serving clients in San Antonio and virtual across Texas.

Link in the first comment.

payload.title: Tue 11/17: Referring providers: the coverage question
payload.purpose: We accept most health insurances; claims processed under patients' mental health benefits. The referral objection that is not clinical.

captions.LI:
One of the most common questions we hear from referring providers: "Will my patient's insurance cover this?"

The Bariatric Counseling Center accepts most health insurances. Claims are processed under patients' mental health benefits.

Our team coordinates care with referring medical providers. At patient discharge, we provide a detailed summary of the patient's behavioral progress during the intensive outpatient program. That includes changes in assessment scores measuring nutrition quality of life, disordered eating, anxiety, and depression, among other metrics.

The program can be standalone behavioral treatment for obesity, or in addition to bariatric surgery or weight loss medication that patients receive from their medical providers.

Our Director of Admissions is Leloni Gonzales. She can answer coverage questions and verify benefits. Reach her at 210-634-2200.

Bariatric Counseling Center serves patients in San Antonio and virtual across Texas.

#BehavioralHealth
